technique_name: Summarize the tools and techniques used in software engineering
description: Software engineering is the use of engineering techniques to develop software in a systematic, efficient and reliable way. This process involves a wide variety of tools and techniques to ensure reliable, secure and efficient software products. Common tools and techniques used in software engineering include requirements gathering, system planning, modeling, design, coding, testing, deployment, security, and maintenance.
